limitations: This is a complete review of the nine short author pages and all 44 raw assessments, with targeted primary-source checks; it is not an exhaustive review of every education study.

Long evidence reports were read only for relevant methods/results: M330 physical 16–17, 61–62, 128–136; M348 physical 43–44, 116–122; DMV executive physical 4–10. Law and draft passages described in individual checks were independently reopened.
The precise ordinance bytes before each author are not authenticated; current law and proposals remain distinct. No unresolved claim is promoted to error and no intent is inferred.
